name: Slicers
remarks: Each Slicer object represents a slicer in a workbook. Slicers are used to filter data.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent SlicerCache object for the specified Slicers collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of objects in the collection.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Returns a Slicer object from the collection. Read-only.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(SlicerDestination As Variant, [Level As Variant], [Name As Variant], [Caption As Variant], [Top As Variant], [Left As Variant], [Width As Variant], [Height As Variant]) As Slicer
methods.description: Creates a new slicer and returns a Slicer object.

parameters.name: SlicerDestination
parameters.description: A String that specifies the name of the sheet, or a Worksheet object that represents the sheet, where the resulting slicer will be placed. The destination sheet must be in the workbook that contains the Slicers object specified by expression.

parameters.name: Level
parameters.description: For OLAP data sources, the ordinal or the Multidimensional Expression (MDX) name of the level on which the slicer creation is based. Not supported for non-OLAP data sources.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the slicer. Excel automatically generates a name if one is not specified. The name must be unique across all slicers within a workbook.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The initial vertical position of the slicer, in points, relative to the upper-left corner of cell A1 on a worksheet.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The initial horizontal position of the slicer, in points, relative to the upper-left corner of cell A1 on a worksheet.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The initial width, in points, of the slicer control.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The initial height, in points, of the slicer control.
